name: Luke Hansen
profile: Luke Hansen ran marketing and sales at his family's Nebraska firm White Castle Roofing, where crews struggled to organise jobsite photos by address. Around 2015 he built CompanyCam, a photo-documentation app for contractors, with a local dev shop. Valued at $2B in Aug 2025, it is Nebraska's first unicorn and is now adding AI features to cut contractors' admin work.
interesting_fact: CompanyCam is the first Nebraska startup to pass a $1B valuation (valued at $2B as of Aug 2025).
deep_cut_fact: The first version was tested on his family's White Castle Roofing crews and a local foundation-repair partner; his brother Dane once quipped, 'Luke had a lot of good ideas — you just had to push him to finish.'
notes: Appears on trade podcasts (e.g. Topline Pro, Roofr). Press inbox published on CompanyCam press page.

name: Wei Youchun
current_role: Co-founder, Tastien (塔斯汀), Fuzhou-based Chinese-style burger chain
profile: Wei Youchun (魏友纯), born in the late 1980s, was a franchise partner of burger chain Wallace (华莱士), running seven of its stores. In 2012 he and two other post-80s partners registered Tastien in Fuzhou, initially selling pizza; it pivoted to hand-rolled 'Chinese burgers' in 2017-19 and has grown to 12,000+ stores.
interesting_fact: Tastien's signature is freshly baked, hand-rolled buns with Chinese fillings like braised pork belly and Peking duck; it now has more than 12,000 stores.
deep_cut_fact: As a Wallace franchisee he timed kitchen serving speeds, calculated burger cost structures and studied store sites for foot traffic; Tastien's first store (selling pizza) opened in Nanchang, Jiangxi.
notes: Very low public profile; no verified contact. Chinese-language outreach via company advisable.
